title: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
描述评分指标或评测协议
材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）
给出任务规模或覆盖范围

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control.
